description: An implementation plan governed by an approved specification must retain every requirement instead of substituting a convenient first tranche.
human_review_requirements: coverage: Check each REQ-001 through REQ-005 against SPEC.md for an actual implementation slice, dependency and verification target. Merely listing IDs does not establish coverage; reject silently removed, narrowed or indefinitely deferred accepted requirements.

claim: Inspect both IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and the final response. They must describe planning-only work and distinguish tranche completion from full-spec implementation; reject contradictory concluding claims.
